description: Copia org-wide Renovate base policy. Extend with local>copia-automation/.github

hostRules.description: Auth for private @copia-automation packages on GitHub Packages, using the RENOVATE_TOKEN secret stored in Mend (desktop-fork already uses it for this registry). Without it lockfile updates fail with 401

lockFileMaintenance.description: Enabled weekly by config:best-practices; moved from its Monday 00:00-03:59 default into the Sunday routine window

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Dependabot security updates own vulnerability PRs: they fix transitive dependencies in yarn.lock, which Renovate cannot. Keep Dependabot alerts and security updates on in every repo that extends this preset

packageRules.description: Rollbacks and replacements should be deliberate human calls, not bot PRs
Overrides and resolutions are deliberate human pins on transitive deps; Renovate must not touch them
Batch patch updates per package manager

All action updates in one PR per repo; action majors rarely need code changes (~40 standalone major PRs across 18 repos). Renovate splits majors into major-github-actions. Only uses: references, so runner OS bumps, container/service images and setup-action version inputs stay out
Runtime group: one PR per Node version across Dockerfiles, .nvmrc and setup-node inputs. Includes patch because the per-manager patch rule splits them by file type. Exclusions mirror group:nodeJs
Runtime group: one PR per Python version across Dockerfiles, .python-version and setup-python inputs. Includes patch for the same reason as node
Runtime group: one PR per Go version across golang images, go.mod go/toolchain directives and setup-go inputs. Includes patch for the same reason as node
Runtime group: the uv image and the uv version in setup-uv inputs bump together (bedrock-agents got two PRs per release). Includes patch for the same reason as node

Family group: eslint, its plugins/configs and parsers move together (9 of the top 20 repos). Built-in groups split them across eslint, typescript-eslint and stylistic. Renovate splits majors into major-eslint
Adds the eslint companions that packages:eslint does not list
Family group: vite drags plugins and vitest with it (6 repos). Separate rules because one rule ANDs its matchers
Adds vitest and @vitest/* to the vite group
Family group: electron needs the packaging toolchain bumped too (4 repos). node-abi must know a new electron ABI before native modules rebuild
Family group: webpack core, CLI/dev-server, loaders and plugins are coupled (4 repos; desktop-fork had 6 standalone loader/plugin PRs)
Family group: pytest plugins track pytest (4 repos)
Family group: golang.org/x modules require each other (x/net needs x/sys) and are all v0, so every bump is a minor (5 repos)
Family group: terraform-aws-modules majors require matching hashicorp/aws provider majors (3 repos)
Family group: Serilog sinks/extensions track Serilog majors (4 .NET repos)
Family group: xunit, its VS runner, the test SDK and coverlet move together (schneider-server, acd-converter). The built-in xunit-dotnet group misses the runner and SDK
WixToolset packages must share one version (zap2zip-server), so patches join too

Storybook packages must share one version (gitea-fork, desktop-fork). Own group so a Storybook regression cannot block the npm batch; majors split into major-storybook. Last so it beats the eslint group for eslint-plugin-storybook. The chromatic CLI versions independently
